question: What are your business hours?
answer: We are open Monday through Friday, 9 AM to 6 PM Eastern Time. We are closed on weekends and major holidays.

question: How can I contact support?
answer: You can reach our support team by phone at (555) 123-4567, by email at support@yourcompany.com, or right here in this chat.

question: What is your refund policy?
answer: We offer a full refund within 30 days of purchase. After 30 days, we can offer store credit. Please have your order number ready and contact support to begin the process.

question: How long does shipping take?
answer: Standard shipping takes 5-7 business days. Express shipping (2-3 days) is available at checkout. You'll receive a tracking number by email once your order ships.

question: How do I reset my password?
answer: Click 'Forgot Password' on the login page and enter your email. You'll receive a reset link within a few minutes. If you don't see it, check your spam folder or contact support.

question: What are your pricing plans?
answer: We offer three plans: Starter ($19/mo), Professional ($49/mo), and Enterprise (custom pricing). Visit our pricing page for a full comparison, or I can connect you with our sales team.
